one_liner: Atomic batch payments in three modes — simple, single-batch, and multi-batch — where every batch lands together or the failing one reverts on-chain.
what_it_does: This lamp bundles many payments into one atomic batch so they settle together instead of one by one. It demonstrated all three modes on the live testnet, including a batch that provably reverted when a receiver refused payment. Proven by 9 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
